name: Acceptance suite-3 test 75 - mutually exclusive conditions prevent correlation (no false critical)
note: IAM-1003 (Phase 10): the modify legs are gated on aws:PrincipalAccount 123456789012 while the assume leg is gated on aws:PrincipalAccount 999900001111. A single principal cannot satisfy both same-key StringEquals pins at once, so no one principal can execute the whole chain. The engine must NOT correlate a compound ROLE-TAKEOVER here; the standalone modification capabilities remain (reported, not hidden), and both condition expressions are preserved in the model.
